name: presentation-skill
description: Source-first PowerPoint/PPTX generation for Codex and ChatGPT agents.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable PowerPoint decks with model-adaptive style routing and QA.
interface.longDescription: A lightweight source-first PowerPoint/PPTX workflow for Codex and ChatGPT agents. Luna, Terra, and Sol receive bounded model-appropriate grammar choices; deterministic scripts turn outline.json, data, and figures into editable decks and run geometry, visual, accessibility, placeholder, and reproducibility QA.
defaultPrompt: Turn this CSV into a lab-style PPTX report.
Redesign this deck and run slide QA.
